configuration.rng_pairing_limit: Calls begin from matched fresh seeds; branch-dependent rejection can consume different draws, so later attempts are not draw-by-draw paired across arms.

criteria_timing: Metrics addendum was read after a seed-0 debug run was inspected and before this three-seed run; added criteria are post-inspection, not preregistered.
label_compatibility: unresolved; CMR labels used only as provisional numerical inputs

model_compatibility.deliberate_adjacency_difference: Canonical decoder returns learned node-dot-product adjacency; generation decoder returns all ones, so adjacency is not included in B/C equivalence.

readiness.decision_logic: Composition readiness requires the frozen protocol's hard checks, a group-bootstrap NLL advantage over fixed-real control, a group-bootstrap accepted-output A/B-recovery yield advantage after projection and common filters, the same positive final direction in every seed, and accepted A/B non-collapse. Forced family X and pre-filter samples cannot satisfy this gate. No yield cutoff was introduced.

reference_information.masked_metric: family-masked A/B-only NLL in nats/site; forced X slots are excluded
